verses.text: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

segments.text: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.text: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

segments.text: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

verses.text: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.

segments.text: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.

verses.text: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.

segments.text: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.

verses.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

segments.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.text: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

segments.text: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

verses.text: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

verses.text: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

segments.text: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

verses.text: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?

verses.text: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”

segments.text: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”

verses.text: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
